requirements.RC-1237: Professional presets are represented as structured export/import data with stable preset identity.
requirements.RC-1238: Custom orb settings are preserved inside the portable preset payload.
requirements.RC-1239: User interpretation templates are preserved inside the portable preset payload.
requirements.RC-1240: Professional logo binary data is rejected when embedded as data/base64 in CSV and is referenced by asset ID instead.
requirements.RC-1241: Binary backup assets are stored below a separate package assets/ directory.
requirements.RC-1242: CSV-compatible binary references use a stable asset:<id> reference.
requirements.RC-1243: A missing optional logo is a non-critical warning and does not invalidate core record restore.
requirements.RC-1244: A missing referenced client ID is critical relational corruption.
requirements.RC-1245: Portable backup package layout and reference semantics are documented as versioned format v1.
requirements.RC-1246: The documented format is designed to remain readable by a future application rewrite.
requirements.RC-1247: An undocumented opaque proprietary binary is not the sole backup representation.
requirements.RC-1248: CSV/JSON records provide a machine-readable copy of user data.

release_blockers: Production archive writer/reader must physically place binary files in assets/ and connect asset references to exported CSV rows.
Professional preset UI persistence/export/import wiring remains required.
Clean-install round-trip with real logo assets remains required.
Exact release artifact and global backup gates remain open.
